ownerLaunchOrder: sample parity alternates provider/owned then owned/provider

workloads.calls: one offer per cycle; full queue prepared outside timing
one offer each cycle; poll every third cycle including cycle zero
clear, refill capacity+capacity/3 to wrap, obtain iterator, advance capacity/2+1, remove, offer; at zero test empty cursor and offer
clear, refill capacity+capacity/3 to wrap, removeAll prebuilt HashSet retaining matches whose integer&15 is zero
clear, refill capacity+capacity/3 to wrap, removeAll prebuilt HashSet retaining matches whose integer&3 is nonzero
offer then addAll fixed ArrayList of 2*capacity+7 values; resulting queue is its suffix
offer then typed toArray alternating a new zero-length Integer[] and reused oversized Integer[capacity+2]; consume length/first/last/null terminator

timingIncludes: Queue calls, refill/clear where stated, iterator and array allocations, return-checksum arithmetic; excludes factory reflection, input generation, SHA256 and snapshot validation
digest: SHA256 outside timing over workload/capacity, consumed return checksum, size and every final queue element; every timed result must match the untimed result and both owners' digests must agree
limits: Five fresh JVMs are descriptive samples, not confidence intervals. Capacity-zero iterator and array cases are empty baselines. No allocation rate, whole-library, nativequeue or cross-machine speed claim. No full correctness corpus added.
